cases.sentence: Когда Бог сотворил ___, Он создал его по подобию Божьему.
cases.translation: When God created man, he made him in God's likeness.
cases.explain: The transitive verb сотворить takes an animate direct object in the accusative (matching the genitive form).

cases.sentence: У него родился сын по его образу и ___.
cases.translation: A son was born to him in his image and likeness.
cases.explain: The preposition по (according to) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: After the birth of Seth, Adam lived 800 years.
cases.explain: The preposition после governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он утешит нас в ___, в тяжком труде рук наших.
cases.translation: He will comfort us in our work, in the hard labor of our hands.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating a state or situation takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Он утешит нас на земле, проклятой ___.
cases.translation: He will comfort us on the earth cursed by the Lord.
cases.explain: The passive participle проклятой takes the agent (the one who curses) in the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Enoch walked with God for three hundred years.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Когда ___ исполнилось 500 лет, у него родились Сим, Хам и Иофет.
cases.translation: When Noah turned 500 years old, Shem, Ham, and Japheth were born to him.
cases.explain: The age construction 'кому исполнилось' (someone turned a certain age) takes the dative case.

cases.translation: This is the genealogy of the descendants of Adam.
cases.explain: The possessive 'descendants of Adam' requires the genitive case.

reading.ru: Когда Адам прожил 130 лет, у него родился сын по его образу и подобию, и он назвал его Сиф.
reading.question: How old was Adam when Seth was born, and what did he name him?
options: He was 130 and named him Seth
He was 105 and named him Enosh
He was 800 and named him Cain
He was 930 and named him Noah
reading.correct: He was 130 and named him Seth
reading.explain: The text says when Adam had lived 130 years a son was born whom he named Seth (Сиф).

reading.ru: Всего Адам жил 930 лет и умер.
reading.question: How many years did Adam live in all?
reading.explain: The text says 'Всего Адам жил 930 лет' (in all Adam lived 930 years).

reading.ru: Енох ходил с Богом, потом его не стало, потому что Бог взял его.
reading.question: What was unusual about the end of Enoch's life?
options: God took him instead of him simply dying
He lived the longest of all
He was the first man to die
reading.correct: God took him instead of him simply dying
reading.explain: The text says 'его не стало, потому что Бог взял его' (he was no more, because God took him).

reading.ru: Всего Мафусал жил 969 лет и умер.
reading.question: How many years did Methuselah live?
reading.explain: The text says 'Всего Мафусал жил 969 лет' (in all Methuselah lived 969 years).

reading.ru: Он назвал его Ной и сказал, «Он утешит нас в работе, в тяжком труде рук наших, на земле, проклятой Господом».
reading.question: Why did Lamech name his son Noah?
options: Because he would comfort them in their labor on the cursed ground
Because he was the firstborn son
reading.correct: Because he would comfort them in their labor on the cursed ground
reading.explain: Lamech says Noah 'утешит нас в работе... на земле, проклятой Господом' (will comfort us in our work on the ground cursed by the Lord).

reading.ru: Когда Ною исполнилось 500 лет, у него родились Сим, Хам и Иофет.
reading.question: Who were born to Noah when he was 500 years old?
reading.explain: The text names 'Сим, Хам и Иофет' (Shem, Ham, and Japheth) as born to Noah at 500 years.
